game.title: Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii

roadmap.title: Complete the main story
roadmap.description: Clear the story through the final chapter. Every story achievement is automatic and nothing is missable. Most side content and all minigames open in Chapter 2, and the rest of the Devil Flags content and the Minato Girls open in Chapter 3, so start dipping into side activities as you go.

roadmap.title: Open-world side content and collection
roadmap.description: Work through the side activities that unlock from Chapter 2 onward: buy abilities, use the combat gadgets, complete bounties, recruit crew, raise Pirate Rank, finish substories and Drink Links, clear the minigames, and collect clothing, treasures, Photo Rally shots, pets, and Gold Balls.

roadmap.title: Devil Flags side story
roadmap.description: Fight the Devil Flags pirates that roam the seas, raise Pirate Rank and collect flags to challenge the three officers and the leader, and play every dark instrument you unlock along the way.

roadmap.title: Pirates' Coliseum and Amon
roadmap.description: Win every Pirates' Coliseum match. Clearing them all, plus the Devil Flags officers, unlocks the Amon Pirates fight, which needs a fully upgraded Majima and ship.

roadmap.title: Clean-up and platinum
roadmap.description: Finish the top Pirate Rank and mop up anything left, then claim the platinum.

achievements.description: Obtained all achievements.
achievements.summary: Unlock every other achievement to earn the platinum.

steps.text: Unlock the other 61 achievements to earn Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 1 of the story.
achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 1 of the main story.

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 1 story missions.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 2 of the story.
achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 2 of the main story.

guide.context: Chapter 2 unlocks most side content and every minigame, along with the Devil Flags and Pirates' Coliseum activities.

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 2 story missions.

achievements.displayName: The Old Man and the Sea
achievements.description: Complete Chapter 3 of the story.
achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 3 of the main story.

guide.context: To continue the story into Madlantis you must first win the 1 Star Tournament of Captains, held at the Pirates' Coliseum. One Coliseum tournament stays locked until Chapter 4.

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 3 story missions, including the required Pirates' Coliseum tournament.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 4 of the story.
achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 4 of the main story.

guide.context: The final Pirates' Coliseum match opens in this chapter, and the story requires the Contention Qualifier tournament before you can challenge Captain Mortimer.

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 4 story missions, including the Contention Qualifier tournament.

achievements.description: Complete the final chapter of the story.
achievements.summary: Complete the final chapter of the main story.

guide.context: After the opening scene the game warns of a point of no return. Speak with Saijima on the Goromaru when you are ready to begin the final part.

steps.text: Finish the final chapter's story missions.

achievements.description: Obtained 10 abilities.
achievements.summary: Obtain 10 abilities.

guide.context: Abilities are bought from Chapter 1 onward. Early ones cost money, and later ones also cost reputation points. The Upgrade Abilities menu shows how many you have.

steps.text: Buy abilities from the Upgrade Abilities menu until you own 10.

achievements.description: Obtained 20 abilities.
achievements.summary: Obtain 20 abilities.

steps.text: Buy abilities until you own 20.

achievements.description: Obtained 40 abilities.
achievements.summary: Obtain 40 abilities.

guide.context: Abilities are purchased with money and reputation points earned from story progress, challenges, and treasure.

steps.text: Buy abilities until you own 40.

achievements.description: Obtained 60 abilities.
achievements.summary: Obtain 60 abilities.

guide.context: There are 87 abilities in total, so this does not require buying every one.

steps.text: Buy abilities until you own 60.

achievements.description: Used the cutlass boomerang on enemies 100 times.
achievements.summary: Hit enemies with the cutlass boomerang 100 times.

guide.context: The cutlass boomerang is a Sea Dog style ability unlocked in Chapter 2. Hits count even when the enemy survives.

steps.text: In Sea Dog style, hold @mechanic{light attack} to throw the cutlass boomerang at enemies and land 100 hits.

achievements.description: Used the chain hook on enemies 50 times.
achievements.summary: Catch 50 enemies with the chain hook.

guide.context: The chain hook is a Sea Dog style ability unlocked in Chapter 2 when the game sends you to the second Julie's Gearworks location.

steps.text: In Sea Dog style, hold @mechanic{grab} near an enemy to pull Majima toward them; do this 50 times.

achievements.description: Used the pistol on enemies 50 times.
achievements.summary: Use the pistol on enemies 50 times.

guide.context: The pistol is a Sea Dog style ability unlocked in Chapter 2 after you first leave Madlantis.

steps.text: In Sea Dog style, hold @mechanic{heavy attack} to charge the pistol, then release to shoot an enemy; land 50 shots.

achievements.description: Created a total of 56 doppelgangers.
achievements.summary: Create 56 doppelgangers.

guide.context: Doppelgangers are summoned in Mad Dog style with a full Madness Gauge. You start with 2 per summon and can raise this to 4 with abilities.

steps.text: In Mad Dog style, fill the @mechanic{Madness Gauge} and press the summon input to create doppelgangers; repeat until the total reaches 56.

achievements.displayName: The Man Who Summoned the Gods
achievements.description: Played every dark instrument.
achievements.summary: Play every dark instrument.

guide.context: Dark instruments are used in Sea Dog style by holding the input and pressing the matching face button with a full Madness Gauge. The first unlocks in the Chapter 2 Devil Flags introduction and the other three drop from the Devil Flags officers.

steps.text: Use each of the four dark instruments at least once.

achievements.description: Summon the gods with dark instruments 30 times.
achievements.summary: Summon the gods 30 times using dark instruments.

guide.context: The Madness Gauge builds slowly by itself. Abilities that add gauge for actions such as cutlass boomerang hits, and heat actions, speed this up. Uses are tracked in Challenges > Battle under the Pirate's Dirge, Captain's Dirge, and Sea God's Dirge challenges.

steps.text: Use any of the dark instruments a total of 30 times.

achievements.description: Equipped rings on all ten fingers at once.
achievements.summary: Equip rings on all ten of Majima's fingers at once.

guide.context: Rings come from treasure, shops, and minigame exchanges. Some rings fit only specific fingers, and duplicates can be worn on different fingers.

steps.text: Open the equipment menu and place a ring in each of the ten finger slots.

achievements.description: Completed 20 bounty missions.
achievements.summary: Complete 20 bounty missions.

guide.context: Bounties unlock in Chapter 2 when the game sends you to the Diamond Head bar. Targets appear on the map as red handcuff icons around Hawaii, Rich Island, and Madlantis.

steps.text: Defeat 20 bounty targets from the map or the Goro Pirates > Bounties menu.

achievements.description: Completed 50 bounty missions.
achievements.summary: Complete 50 bounty missions.

guide.context: There are 86 bounties in total, and more appear as the story progresses. The game texts you when new targets unlock.

steps.text: Defeat 50 bounty targets from the map or the Goro Pirates > Bounties menu.

achievements.description: Achieved the rank of Sea Legs-Havers.
achievements.summary: Reach the Pirate Rank of Sea Legs-Havers.

guide.context: Pirate Rank rises from Challenges that award Reputation and from collecting treasure. The full list is under Goro Pirates > Challenges.

steps.text: Earn Reputation from challenges and treasure until the Pirate Rank reaches Sea Legs-Havers.

achievements.description: Achieved the rank of Popular Picaroons.
achievements.summary: Reach the Pirate Rank of Popular Picaroons.

guide.context: Rank continues to rise from Reputation earned through challenges and treasure.

steps.text: Keep earning Reputation until the Pirate Rank reaches Popular Picaroons.

achievements.description: Achieved the rank of Buccaneer Bigshots.
achievements.summary: Reach the Pirate Rank of Buccaneer Bigshots.

steps.text: Keep earning Reputation until the Pirate Rank reaches Buccaneer Bigshots.

achievements.description: Achieved the rank of Legends of the Sea.
achievements.summary: Raise your Pirate Rank to Legends of the Sea.

guide.context: You do not need to complete every challenge. Collecting treasure and finishing other activities covers most of the Reputation required.

steps.text: Keep earning Reputation until the Pirate Rank reaches Legends of the Sea.

achievements.description: Recruited 30 members to the Goro Pirates.
achievements.summary: Recruit 30 crew members into the Goro Pirates.

guide.context: From Chapter 2 you can recruit crew around Hawaii and Madlantis by meeting each person's request, shown on the map. Substories, minigame point exchanges, and DLC packs also provide crew.

steps.text: Recruit crew members around Hawaii and Madlantis until the total reaches 30.

achievements.description: Recruited 50 members to the Goro Pirates.
achievements.summary: Recruit 50 crew members into the Goro Pirates.

steps.text: Recruit crew members until the total reaches 50.

achievements.description: Recruited 80 members to the Goro Pirates.
achievements.summary: Recruit 80 crew members into the Goro Pirates.

guide.context: More than 100 crew members exist in total, so plenty are available beyond the story recruits.

steps.text: Recruit crew members until the total reaches 80.

achievements.description: Viewed all of Noah's Drink Links.
achievements.summary: View all of Noah's Drink Links.

guide.context: From Chapter 2 all 30 of Noah's Bond Chats are marked on the map. Completing 10 chats unlocks a Drink Link event at Revolve Bar.

steps.text: Complete all 30 of Noah's Bond Chats around Hawaii.
View the 3 Drink Link events at Revolve Bar once the chats are done.

achievements.description: Viewed every Drink Link with the crew.
achievements.summary: View every Drink Link with the crew.

guide.context: This covers the other 4 ship crew members. Each has 5 Bond Chats done on the water while piloting the ship, followed by a Drink Link inside the Goromaru. Jason and Masaru open first; the rest open in Chapter 3 and at the start of Chapter 4.

steps.text: For each of the 4 crew members, complete their 5 Bond Chats out at sea.
View each crew member's Drink Link event inside the Goromaru.

achievements.description: Won 10 different matches in the Pirates' Coliseum.
achievements.summary: Win 10 different Pirates' Coliseum matches.

guide.context: The Pirates' Coliseum becomes available late in Chapter 2 and pits your ship and boarding crew against arena opponents.

steps.text: Win 10 different matches at the Pirates' Coliseum.

achievements.description: Won 20 different matches in the Pirates' Coliseum.
achievements.summary: Win 20 different Pirates' Coliseum matches.

steps.text: Win 20 different matches at the Pirates' Coliseum.

achievements.description: Won 30 different matches in the Pirates' Coliseum.
achievements.summary: Win 30 different Pirates' Coliseum matches.

guide.context: Every match must be won anyway to unlock the Amon Pirates fight.

steps.text: Win every Pirates' Coliseum match, 30 in total.

achievements.description: Defeat the Amon Pirates in the Pirates' Coliseum.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Amon Pirates.

guide.context: The fight unlocks only after clearing every other Coliseum match, which also needs the Devil Flags officers and leader beaten. Fully upgrade Majima and the ship first. Good ship weapons are the Super Laser Cannon, the Energy Cannon, and the Super Coconut Machine Gun when you can craft it.

steps.text: Win the ship battle against Amon's ship. Boost past its opening rockets, fire machine guns at its stern to stop its movement, and pop smoke if you are set on fire.
On deck, clear the 50 enemies. Open with the shark attack, use the pistol heat attack, block Amon's area-damage deck ability, and pick off the named enemies.
Bring healing items and beat Amon one-on-one. Save the Madness attack for when he summons clones and block his flying knives.

achievements.description: Win the battle on Rokka Island.
achievements.summary: Win the battle on Rokka Island.

guide.context: This happens automatically during Chapter 2 as the Devil Flags introduction and cannot be missed.

steps.text: Complete the Chapter 2 Devil Flags battle on Rokka Island.

achievements.description: Defeat the first Devil Flags officer.
achievements.summary: Defeat the first Devil Flags officer.

guide.context: After the Chapter 2 introduction, Devil Flags pirates appear on the maps as red devil icons. The first officer can be challenged at Pirate Rank 2 with at least 70 flags.

steps.text: Reach Pirate Rank 2, collect 70 flags, then defeat the first Devil Flags officer.

achievements.description: Defeat the second Devil Flags officer.
achievements.summary: Defeat the second Devil Flags officer.

steps.text: Reach Pirate Rank 3, collect 130 flags, then defeat the second Devil Flags officer.

achievements.description: Defeat the third Devil Flags officer.
achievements.summary: Defeat the third Devil Flags officer.

steps.text: Reach Pirate Rank 4, collect 220 flags, then defeat the third Devil Flags officer.

achievements.description: Defeat the leader of the Devil Flags.
achievements.summary: Beat the Devil Flags' leader.

guide.context: The leader requires Pirate Rank 5 and at least 330 flags. Final Heaven holds no treasure and no extra enemy fleet, so you can sail straight through it.

steps.text: Reach Pirate Rank 5, collect 330 flags, then defeat Captain Zeus.

achievements.description: Completed 10 different islands.
achievements.summary: Complete 10 different islands.

guide.context: You reach islands by sailing the open sea. Each one holds enemies and treasure, and other side activities will take you past 10.

steps.text: Sail to islands and clear each one until 10 are complete.

achievements.description: Obtained 10 different treasures.
achievements.summary: Obtain 10 different treasures.

guide.context: Treasures are unique items found on islands or in Hawaii, Rich Island, and Madlantis. Many also give money and reputation, and some are rings.

steps.text: Find and pick up 10 different treasures.

achievements.description: Obtained 40 different treasures.
achievements.summary: Obtain 40 different treasures.

guide.context: The dark instruments you gain during the Devil Flags story also count toward the treasure total, and minigame vendors sell chests if you need more.

steps.text: Find and pick up 40 different treasures.

achievements.description: Obtained 50 customization parts for the Goromaru.
achievements.summary: Collect 50 parts to customize the Goromaru.

guide.context: Parts become available in Chapter 2 at Madlantis and come from shops, the customization menu, and minigame point exchanges. There are 74 parts in the base game.

steps.text: Buy or trade for Goromaru customization parts until you own 50.

achievements.description: Created three different cannons at Julie's Gearworks.
achievements.summary: Build three distinct cannons at Julie's Gearworks.

guide.context: Once Clark and Julie upgrade the Goromaru in Chapter 2, you can craft at any Julie's Gearworks location. Missing materials can be bought from pawn shops or collected by sailing through currents.

steps.text: Craft any 3 distinct cannons at a Julie's Gearworks location.

achievements.description: Sunk 5 enemy ships with the rocket launcher.
achievements.summary: Use the deck rocket launcher to sink 5 enemy ships.

guide.context: The rocket launcher is used while standing on the ship deck by holding the aim input and firing. The ship-mounted weapons do not count.

steps.text: During ship battles, stand on deck, aim the rocket launcher at an enemy ship, and sink it; sink 5 ships this way.

achievements.description: Cooked all recipes.
achievements.summary: Cook every recipe in the Goro Goro Kitchen.

guide.context: You need Chef Lv 24, the Goro Goro Booze Master ability from Shared Abilities, the upgraded Goromaru from Chapter 2 for the crew recipes, and several animals in the Goro Goro Kingdom for the final recipe. Progress is tracked in Challenges > Adventure.

steps.text: Reach Chef Lv 24, then buy Goro Goro Booze Master from the Shared Abilities list.
Cook every recipe, including the crew recipes unlocked by the upgraded Goromaru and the final recipe unlocked by visiting the Goro Goro Kingdom with several animals.

achievements.description: Obtained 20 types of clothing items.
achievements.summary: Obtain 20 types of clothing items.

guide.context: Clothing becomes available in Chapter 2 at Madlantis and comes from the outfit menu, Hawaii clothing shops, minigame point trades, and chests. It is cosmetic.

steps.text: Collect 20 different clothing items.

achievements.description: Obtained 50 types of clothing items.
achievements.summary: Obtain 50 types of clothing items.

steps.text: Collect 50 different clothing items.

achievements.description: Obtained 100 types of clothing items.
achievements.summary: Obtain 100 types of clothing items.

guide.context: The Outfit menu lists where each locked item is obtained, and progress is tracked in Challenges > Adventure.

steps.text: Collect 100 different clothing items.

achievements.description: Took 30 different photos for the Photo Rally.
achievements.summary: Take 30 different Photo Rally photos.

guide.context: The Photo Rally unlocks automatically in Chapter 2. There are 100 photo spots across Hawaii, Rich Island, and Madlantis, and only 30 are required.

steps.text: Take 30 different photos at marked Photo Rally spots.

achievements.description: Befriended 50 people through Aloha Links.
achievements.summary: Befriend 50 people through Aloha Links.

guide.context: Aloha Links unlocks in Chapter 2. Greet people around the city, interact with them at shops, or defend them from enemies. There are 200 people in Honolulu.

steps.text: Use Aloha Links to befriend 50 people around Honolulu.

achievements.description: Traveled using the chain hook 20 times.
achievements.summary: Use the chain hook to travel to 20 grapple points.

guide.context: The chain hook is unlocked in Chapter 2 at the second Julie's Gearworks location. Out of combat it grapples to marked spots.

steps.text: Aim at a marked grapple point and use the chain hook to pull Majima to it; do this 20 times.

achievements.description: Captured 30 fish and bugs with the chain hook.
achievements.summary: Use the chain hook to catch 30 fish or bugs.

guide.context: Fish and bugs appear in the water and air around Hawaii and Rich Island.

steps.text: Use the chain hook on 30 fish or bugs.

achievements.description: Completed 10 substories.
achievements.summary: Complete 10 substories.

guide.context: Substories start appearing in Chapter 2 around Hawaii and usually reward a crew member.

steps.text: Complete 10 substories around Hawaii.

achievements.description: Completed 20 substories.
achievements.summary: Complete 20 substories.

guide.context: There are 31 substories in total, so this does not require finishing all of them.

steps.text: Complete 20 substories around Hawaii.

achievements.description: Partied with the Minato Girls and found true love.
achievements.summary: Party with the Minato Girls and find true love.

guide.context: Each Minato Girl has her own substory, and all five open in Chapter 3. The five are Ena, Kaho, Misoshi, Ai, and Seiko.

steps.text: Complete each Minato Girl's substory, then finish the final substory that follows.

achievements.description: Played 10 different minigames.
achievements.summary: Play 10 different minigames.

guide.context: There are 21 minigames, and at least 4 are used by other achievements, so any 6 more count.

steps.text: Play any 10 different minigames.

achievements.description: Won 3 different cups in Dragon Kart.
achievements.summary: Win three cups in Dragon Kart.

guide.context: Dragon Kart opens in Chapter 2 once you finish the substory Dragon Kart in Paradise, found at the dock south of Harbor St. Each cup is a set of 3 races, and a top-3 finish unlocks the next cup.

steps.text: Win 3 Dragon Kart cups.

achievements.description: Enjoyed karaoke on the deck of the Goromaru.
achievements.summary: Perform a karaoke song aboard the Goromaru.

guide.context: Karaoke becomes available once Clark and Julie upgrade the ship in Chapter 2. The machine is inside the rear cabin of the ship.

steps.text: Interact with the karaoke machine in the Goromaru cabin and sing one song.

achievements.description: Obtained 5 certificates from the Ounabara Vocational School.
achievements.summary: Earn 5 certificates at the Ounabara Vocational School.

guide.context: The school opens in Chapter 2 after completing the substory The Smartest Pirate Crew!. Any 5 exams count.

steps.text: Pass 5 exams at the Ounabara Vocational School.

achievements.description: Completed all Crazy Delivery courses.
achievements.summary: Complete all Crazy Delivery courses.

guide.context: Crazy Delivery starts in Chapter 2 through the substory Stay Crazy, at the fountain near Sunset St. and Downtown St. There are 4 courses there and 4 more at the Aloha St. location.

steps.text: Complete the first course during the Stay Crazy substory, then the remaining 3 at that spot and all 4 at the Aloha St. location.

achievements.description: Destroyed a total of 1,500 barrels at the Bang Bang Batting Center.
achievements.summary: Destroy 1,500 barrels in the Bang Bang Batting Center minigame.

guide.context: The Bang Bang Batting Center is in Madlantis and opens in Chapter 2. You fire cannonballs at stacks of explosive targets to score. Progress is tracked in Challenges > Entertainment.

steps.text: Play the Bang Bang Batting Center until you have destroyed 1,500 barrels.

achievements.description: Obtained 7 pets.
achievements.summary: Obtain 7 pets.

guide.context: The Goro Kingdom on Rich Island is introduced in Chapter 1, and 3 pets join during the story. The rest appear as paw print markers on the map after you get the cat Onigiri in Chapter 2.

steps.text: Collect the 3 story pets, then visit the paw print locations around Hawaii until you have 7 pets.

achievements.description: Obtained 2 balls.
achievements.summary: Obtain 2 Golden Balls.

guide.context: Golden Balls only appear from Chapter 3, when Captain Beef starts the request for them. Use the Hook to grab them.

steps.text: After starting When You Wish Upon Some Balls, use the Hook to grab the Golden Ball on the Shinobi Sushi sign, on the ninja standing to the right of the restaurant entrance.
Grab the Golden Ball inside the Treasure Select Pawn shop on Hula Avenue, on the masked statue in the window. This second ball earns the achievement.
